stem: A child with severe pneumonia has pneumatoceles on chest imaging and has not improved with amoxicillin. Which organism is most likely?
explanation: Pneumatoceles are classically associated with staphylococcal pneumonia. Failure to respond to amoxicillin also supports considering Staphylococcus aureus, including resistant strains depending on context.
